items.q: What is the WanAI 3.0 Video Generator?
items.a: WanAI is an independent AI video creation website offering Wan models. Generate short clips from text, images, and reference videos, then view and download results in My videos.

items.q: What can I create with Wan 3.0?
items.a: Wan 3.0 can be used for product videos, ads, social content, cinematic scenes, explainers, concept videos, and reference-driven creative projects.

items.q: How long can Wan 3.0 videos be?
items.a: Without a reference video, Wan 3.0 can generate up to 30 seconds. With reference videos, input and output duration together must stay within 30 seconds; reference inputs can total up to 15 seconds.
Yes. Wan 3.0 supports video output up to 1080p, making it suitable for product content, advertising, websites, presentations, and other higher-resolution workflows.

items.q: What types of input does Wan 3.0 support?
items.a: The current inputs are text prompts, JPG / PNG / WebP images, and MP4 / MOV reference videos. Images are limited to 10 MiB each. Reference videos are limited to 100 MiB each, 1–15 seconds per clip, and 15 seconds total. Audio and document uploads are not currently available on this site.

items.q: Can I turn an image into a video with Wan 3.0?
items.a: Yes. Upload an image and describe the motion, camera direction, environment, and ending you want. Wan 3.0 can use the image as visual guidance for the generated video.

items.q: Can Wan 3.0 generate videos with native audio?
items.a: Audio generation is enabled for current Wan 3.0 requests. You can describe ambience or sound effects in your prompt, but the model determines the result. Separate audio editing and audio uploads are not available on this site.
